general_information.name: I’M NOT SURE IF YOU MEAN THE NAME ON MY HEALTH CARD OR LIKE… THE PAPERWORK NAME? I USUALLY JUST SAY JOANNE, AND THERE’S A SURNAME, BUT I MIGHT BE MIXING UP WHAT YOU’RE ASKING. COULD YOU SAY IT ANOTHER WAY?

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s been a mix of things, really… I get tearful and snappy, and my sleep is all over the place with night sweats. It’s been going on for quite a while — I think about three years — and I’ve been finding it hard to concentrate at work too.
current_concerns.goals: Mostly I want to sleep through the night, honestly. And stop snapping at my family… that would be a big relief.

medications.current_medications: Medication 1: Name Or Description: Transdermal oestradiol.; Dose: One patch twice weekly.; Start Or Duration: Started in 2025.; Side Effects: Just some mild skin irritation from the patch.

family_psychiatric_history.family_psychiatric_history_details: Family member 1: Name Or Description: My mother.; Diagnosis Or Condition: Depression during menopause.; Additional Details: She was treated with medication. No, those are all.

substance_use.nonmedical_alcohol_use: Status: Current; Substance or product: Wine.; Quantity or frequency: Two glasses, three evenings a week… I think that’s the usual amount. It's been that way for about twenty years.; Duration: About twenty years.

education_employment_legal_history.employment_history: Job 1: Name Or Description: Crestline Group.; Job Title: Human resources advisor.; Dates: 2004 to present.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and raised in Toronto, and it was just an ordinary, happy childhood really — nothing much out of the ordinary.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I completed a business degree, and honestly there weren’t any significant difficulties that stand out from then.
personal_history.significant_relationships: My marriage — that’s current, and it’s been 24 years. We have two adult children too.
personal_history.future_goals: I just want to feel steady again and enjoy work.
